newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Statistics Sweden updates CPI method, March figure.
newsitem.headline: Statistics Sweden updates CPI method, March figure.

text.p: Sweden's official data bureau Statistics Sweden said on Tuesday that from April 1997 it would change its method of calculating the consumer price index and that March figures were revised upwards based on the new method.

"The effect on the 12 month rate of inflation for the total CPI index has been preliminarily calculated at an increase of 0.4 percentage points for March, making the rate of inflation 0.0 percent instead of a fall of 0.4 percent," Statistics Sweden said in a statement.
It said the old method of calculating CPI was not entirely compatible with the proper method of calculating CPI.
"The method used until now has undervalued household interest costs for the repayment of property loans," Statistics Sweden said.
When April consumer price index data is published on May 15 at 0715 GMT, it will include revised figures for the period from January 1995 to March 1997.
